full_judgment: 5. At the trial the plaintiff examined 6 witnesses including the plaintiff herself as PW 1 and the defendant examined 4 witnesses, the defendant No.1 as DW 1. The plaintiff proved the bainapatra, exhibit-2, and the kabala what she had obtained from the defendant No. 2 in pursuance of the compromise in the suit. The relevant khatian is exhibit-3 and the solenama between the plaintiff and the defendant No. 2 is exhibit-4. The defendant exhibited a complaint lodged with the local Union Parishad on 5.1.74 as exhibit 'Ka' against the plaintiff and her brother Shafiullah for order of recovery of three blank stamp papers, two registered kabalas and one copy of khatian No. 503. The kabala said to have been executed by defendant Nos. 1 and 2 in favour of the defendant No. 1 named Broshi Debi which was registered on 25.4.74, exhibit 'Kha'.
